classification_rules.ACCEPTED_FORWARD_ONLY_requires: a legitimate/authorized prospective capture path with a tested payload or a repository-forward-capture contract; historical original vintage not proven
classification_rules.ACCEPTED_FOR_PHASE1L_requires: a tested payload (sample/trial/sandbox/entitled) proving every historical requirement above on the archetype sample, plus a live path
classification_rules.evidence_standard: Actual API reference/schema/documentation pages or repository payloads. Marketing text alone never supports a pass. A documented endpoint is not evidence of retained original versions.
classification_rules.no_payload_tested: must be written explicitly as NO_PROVIDER_PAYLOAD_TESTED for that provider
classification_rules.prices: never invented; unknown = CONTACT SALES / UNKNOWN

commit_order: results, scorecard, findings, forward plan, registry/inventory

cutoffs.kickoff_utc: nflverse games.csv gameday + gametime interpreted as America/New_York, converted to UTC

forward_capture_design_requirements: raw layer (provider, retrieved_at, published_at, payload_hash, game, team, player, raw_payload_reference)

historical_reopen_numeric_thresholds.scope: all 544 regular-season 2024 team-games, T24 and T90 evaluated separately; both cutoffs must pass for BOTH, otherwise the cutoff that passes is named

live_payload_policy: No Week 5+ (2026) player-state payload is opened in this phase. Live/forward capability is judged from documentation, release metadata and the forward-capture design; any live acceptance run needs its own authorization and protocol.
no_provider_payload_statement: Any provider whose payload was not actually opened is recorded with NO_PROVIDER_PAYLOAD_TESTED. A passing acceptance is never fabricated.

labels.CHANGE_TO_PRIOR_BACKUP_OR_RETURN: target_top_qb != prior_qb and has >0 earlier 2024 attempts (injury replacement, returning starter or benching are not separable from realized data and are not claimed)
labels.MULTI_QB_GAME: a second QB has >=10 target-game attempts
labels.NEW_OR_SURPRISE_QB: target_top_qb has zero 2024 attempts in earlier weeks (rookie promotion, acquisition or emergency are not separable from realized data and are not claimed)
labels.STABLE_VETERAN: target_top_qb == prior_qb == top QB two games earlier, and target_top_qb has >=80% of target-game team QB attempts and >=20 prior 2024 attempts
labels.precedence: MULTI_QB_GAME, then NEW_OR_SURPRISE_QB, then CHANGE_TO_PRIOR_BACKUP_OR_RETURN, then STABLE_VETERAN; rows matching none are unsampled
labels.prior_qb: QB with most pass attempts for the team in the most recent prior regular-season game (ties: lexicographically smaller player_id)
labels.target_top_qb: QB with most attempts for the team in the target game (ties: smaller player_id)

preregistered_archetype_sample.not_separable_archetypes: injury replacement, starter returning from injury, rookie promotion, benching and recent acquisition require independent pregame evidence; they are reported as NOT_SEPARABLE_WITHOUT_ACCEPTED_SOURCE rather than inferred from outcomes
preregistered_archetype_sample.population: 2024 REG team-games, weeks 3-18 (needs two prior 2024 games), from nflverse stats_player_week_2024.csv (sha256 pinned to the Phase1H manifest) and the 2024 REG rows of games.csv (allowlisted columns only; no betting columns).
preregistered_archetype_sample.purpose: Predefine the acceptance sample so the source is never judged on examples chosen because it looks correct. Archetype labels use realized 2024 team-game passer attempts ONLY to stratify the sample (never as a feature, never scored).
preregistered_archetype_sample.selection: for each label take the 4 team-games with the smallest sha256(game_id + '|' + team + '|phase1m-sample-v1') hex digest; total at most 16 team-games

prior_continuity_hint_audit.rule: Run ONLY if certified pregame starter rows exist; otherwise record NOT_RUN_NO_CERTIFIED_STARTER_STATE. Hints are diagnostic and are never promoted.

providers_to_investigate: historical roster/depth providers (public web archives, aggregators)
legitimate data already present in the repository
question: What could the model legitimately have known BEFORE kickoff, at T24 and T90, about expected starting QB, depth-chart state, QB injury/practice status, starter changes, replacement situations and uncertainty? Not: who eventually started.
reject_source_if: it only shows who eventually started
records are backfilled after games without original timestamps
starter state depends on target-game participation
mutable webpages have no archived/versioned state

reopen_decision_rule.PHASE1L_BLOCKED_PENDING_VENDOR_ACCESS: no pass, but at least one vendor is PROMISING_NEEDS_SAMPLE or PROMISING_NEEDS_CONTRACT where only a sample/contract/trial request stands between us and an acceptance test
reopen_decision_rule.PHASE1L_CAN_REOPEN_FORWARD_ONLY: no historical pass, and at least one source classified ACCEPTED_FORWARD_ONLY (legitimate prospective path, tested payload or an authorized live contract) - forward-only data never validates Phase1L on 2024
reopen_decision_rule.PHASE1L_CAN_REOPEN_HISTORICALLY: at least one source classified ACCEPTED_FOR_PHASE1L or ACCEPTED_HISTORICAL_ONLY with every numeric threshold met on a tested payload

repository_depth_timing_probe.interpretation_limit: dt means when the data record was loaded, not when a starter was announced; ESPN-derived reuse rights are unresolved; coverage does not certify starter state
repository_depth_timing_probe.metrics: per team-game: latest QB-bearing snapshot with dt <= cutoff for T24 and T90, its age in hours, whether a rank-1 QB row exists; counts only
repository_depth_timing_probe.scope: 2025 REG team-games; reads dt, team and QB position rows only; opens NO passer, outcome, performance or 2026 labels
repository_depth_timing_probe.why: nflverse depth_charts_2025.csv carries a loaded timestamp dt. Measure timing coverage only.

scope: DATA ENGINEERING / SOURCE QUALIFICATION ONLY. No predictive model fitting, no QB attempt or passing-yard fitting, no 2024 model fitting, no 2025 validation, no 2026 diagnostics, no Monte Carlo, no sportsbook data.
source_acceptance_requirements_to_reopen: enough coverage for the Phase1L primary population

temporal_integrity.visibility_rule: A record is visible only if publication_timestamp (or, when the provider gives none, retrieval_timestamp) <= cutoff AND retrieval_timestamp <= cutoff AND valid_from <= cutoff AND (valid_to is null OR cutoff < valid_to) AND postgame_only_flag is false AND (backfilled_flag is false OR original_vintage_flag is true) AND cutoff_eligibility covers the requested cutoff. Among visible revisions of one source record the highest revision_sequence wins. No later revision may leak backward.

capture_status.POST_CUTOFF_ONLY_UNKNOWN: returned snapshot > cutoff; a pre-cutoff snapshot may exist but the Availability API does not enumerate versions
capture_status.PRE_CUTOFF_WITHIN_72H: returned snapshot timestamp <= cutoff and >= cutoff - 72h

wayback_probe_rule.disclosure_exploratory_calls: Before this protocol was registered, 10 exploratory Availability API calls (5 URLs x 2 timestamps, early/mid October 2024) were made to learn whether the API is reachable. They are not part of the sample and were not used to choose it.
wayback_probe_rule.limits: The CDX enumeration endpoint is blocked by this environment's egress policy and is not used. No archived page body is opened or parsed: archived third-party content terms/licensing are unresolved, and a snapshot that exists is not proof it displays a certified starter state. Therefore every content-level acceptance question stays NOT_TESTED for this source.
wayback_probe_rule.requests: each (team-game in the sample) x (T24, T90) x (3 families); the query timestamp is the cutoff
wayback_probe_rule.throttle: at most one request per 6 seconds; stop at the first HTTP 429 and record NOT_COMPLETED with the count completed
wayback_probe_rule.why: Public web archives are the only non-licensed route to original-vintage 2024 pregame pages. Probe EXISTENCE and capture timestamps only through the documented Internet Archive Availability API (archive.org/wayback/available).
